items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe has also released an isolated patch for these issues.

items.title: Mirasvit Cache Warmer Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection (PolyShell)
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie. This flaw, also referred to as PolyShell, has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This vulnerability, part of APSB26-49, is a Stored XSS issue with a CVSS score of 8.7, which could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Identified within APSB26-49, this Path Traversal vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.7 and could result in arbitrary file system write.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application.

items.title: Denial-of-Service in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This denial-of-service vulnerability stems from a vulnerable third-party component, allowing unauthenticated network-based attackers to crash Adobe Commerce instances.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise customer accounts.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of APSB26-05, this Stored XSS vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.7 and could lead to privilege escalation, requiring admin access to exploit.

items.title: SessionReaper - Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical bug allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks exploiting this vulnerability were observed in the wild in October 2025 and continued into March 2026.
